note: Single source of truth for the writeups index. Each `file` is a body-only Markdown file under data/writeups/. OS, difficulty, tags and summaries were inferred during migration from Notion - edit freely. status: complete | partial | stub.

writeups.title: 12 Week Project
writeups.summary: Custom binex challenge combining reversing, format-string PIE bypass, a hardcoded canary, and a ret-to-printme exploit.

writeups.title: CSCTF: Key Custody
writeups.summary: JWT KID directory-traversal to sign a forged admin token using a known public file on the server.

writeups.title: CSCTF: Operation Dawn - The Command Seal
writeups.summary: XXE entity injection to read a file, then replay a forged order to bypass auth and retrieve the flag.

writeups.title: CSCTF: Operation Dawn - The Access Log
writeups.summary: Reconstruct a blind SQL injection flag from access-log timing side-channels by filtering on response time.

writeups.title: Heap 3
writeups.summary: Use-after-free: free an object, reallocate into the same slot, and overwrite the flag field to pass the win check.

writeups.title: Heap 2
writeups.summary: Heap overflow to overwrite a function pointer with the address of win, redirecting execution to print the flag.

writeups.title: Heap 1
writeups.summary: Basic heap overflow: write 32 bytes past the input buffer to overwrite safe_var with 'pico' and trigger the win check.

writeups.title: Format String 3
writeups.summary: GOT overwrite via format-string: replace puts with system in the GOT so the final puts('/bin/sh') pops a shell.

writeups.title: Format String 2
writeups.summary: Format-string arbitrary write: use fmtstr_payload to overwrite the 'sus' global variable and pass the win condition.

writeups.title: Format String 1
writeups.summary: Basic format-string leak: spray %p to find secret-menu data on the stack, then decode the little-endian flag.

writeups.title: Buffer Overflow 3
writeups.summary: Brute-force a 4-byte static canary one character at a time, then ret-to-win past the overwritten stack frame.

writeups.title: Reverse 5: Bbbbloat
writeups.summary: Stripped PIE binary with a hardcoded compare: find the hex constant in radare2 and convert to decimal for the flag.

writeups.title: Reverse 4: Bit-O-Asm-4
writeups.summary: Trace x86-64 assembly by hand: a cmp/jle branch leads to a subtract, yielding the eax value 654773.

writeups.title: Reverse 3: FactCheck
writeups.summary: Dynamic analysis in GDB: break after runtime string concatenation and read the assembled flag from rdx.

writeups.title: Reverse 2: Packer
writeups.summary: UPX-packed binary: unpack with upx -d, then find the hardcoded hex flag string next to 'Password correct'.

writeups.title: Reverse 1: weirdSnake
writeups.summary: Reverse Python bytecode: reconstruct the key string from BINARY_OP ordering, extend and XOR against the input list.

writeups.title: WingData
writeups.summary: Wing FTP null-byte RCE, salt-cracked creds, then a root symlink attack on a sudo backup-restore script.

writeups.title: BlueEdge (Second Round)
writeups.summary: Child-to-parent domain escalation: DCSync the krbtgt, forge a Golden Ticket, then PsExec across.

writeups.title: Thing
